generate_text_with_openai_llm: create an OpenAILLM instance and call generate to produce text from a prompt using the configured model
generate_with_conversational_context: use generate_with_context to send a system message and message history to the LLM for multi-turn generation
configure_reasoning_model_parameters: set max_completion_tokens and reasoning_effort when using o1, o3, or gpt-5 reasoning models
enable_manual_human_in_the_loop_mode: enable manual_mode to write prompts to a task queue directory and poll for human-provided answer JSON files
call_openai_api_with_retries: use the built-in retry logic with configurable retries and retry_delay to handle transient API failures
